name: BlueStacks Realtime CPU & IO Priority (HD-Player.exe)

name: NoxPlayer & MEMU Realtime CPU Priority (Nox.exe & MEmu.exe)
description: Configures Windows IFEO to execute NoxPlayer and MEMU emulator processes with High CPU Priority and high thread scheduling preference.

name: Force Discrete High-Performance GPU for All Android Emulators
description: Forces Windows DirectX graphics runtime to route all Android emulator rendering through your high-power discrete GPU.

name: Disable CPU Power Throttling & EcoQoS for Emulators
description: Stops Windows 10/11 from throttling multi-threaded Android emulator processes to slow efficiency states.

name: Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO) Micro-Stutter Fix
description: Eliminates infamous Desktop Window Manager multi-plane overlay frame drops, black screens, and micro-stutters across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.

name: DirectX Shader Cache Maximize (1GB+ for Zero Stutter)
description: Sets the global DirectX shader disk cache to 1GB to prevent in-game shader compilation stutters in modern games and 3D emulators.

name: Windows Visual Effects - Ultimate Gaming Performance Mode
description: Disables window animations, menu fade delays, drop shadows, and taskbar transition latency while keeping crisp ClearType font rendering.

name: Mouse 1:1 Raw Response (No Acceleration)
description: Disables Windows mouse acceleration curves and smoothing thresholds for true 1:1 pixel-perfect pointer tracking.

name: Disable Xbox Game Bar & Background DVR
description: Stops background game clip broadcasting and game overlay capture hooks that cause frame stutters and input lag.

name: MMCSS High-Priority Gaming Scheduler
description: Directs Windows Multimedia Class Scheduler Service to allocate maximum CPU and GPU cycles to active game threads.

name: Fast Keyboard Repeat Response (Low Delay)
description: Sets shortest repeat delay (0) and max repeat rate (31) for immediate movement and key engagement in esports titles.

name: Disable Global Fullscreen Optimizations
description: Enforces exclusive fullscreen display presentation in DirectX games, bypassing desktop compositor buffering lag.

name: Disable Windows Network Throttling
description: Removes the default 10 packet/ms network traffic throttling limit, unleashing maximum network throughput and lower ping.

name: Zero Network System Responsiveness Reserve
description: Eliminates the 20% system/network bandwidth reserved for background Windows tasks, allocating 100% to your active game.

name: TCP NoDelay & Disable Delayed ACK
description: Disables Nagle's algorithm and delayed packet acknowledgment for immediate packet transmission with zero buffering queue.

name: TCP Window Auto-Tuning & High-Performance Scaling
description: Enables RFC 1323 TCP timestamps and window scaling for maximum bandwidth utilization and stable low-jitter connections.

name: Disable NetBIOS Peer Discovery Broadcast Delays
description: Stops local subnet broadcast resolution queries that cause periodic network spikes during online gaming.

name: Win32 Priority Separation (Foreground Quantum Boost)
description: Sets process scheduling quantum to 26 (0x1A), allocating maximum CPU execution slices to active foreground apps and games.

name: Disable Paging Executive (Lock Kernel in RAM)
description: Forces Windows kernel drivers and system executive code to reside in high-speed physical RAM rather than pagefile on disk.

name: Prioritize App Memory Over System File Cache
description: Sets LargeSystemCache=0 to ensure working set memory is dedicated to running games rather than Windows file system caching.

name: Disable CPU Core Parking (Unpark All Cores)
description: Prevents Windows power manager from sleeping secondary CPU cores, avoiding micro-stutter when cores wake up under load.

name: Disable Memory Compression (16GB+ RAM Systems)
description: Disables background RAM page compression, reducing CPU overhead and eliminating compression micro-spikes on high-RAM rigs.

name: Zero Menu Show Delay (Instant Context Menus)
description: Eliminates the built-in 400ms delay when hovering and opening context menus, making Windows feel instantaneous.

name: Fast Hung App & Service Termination (2s Timeout)
description: Reduces hung application and service termination delays from 12-20s down to 2s, enabling swift restarts and shutdowns.

name: Disable Aero Shake Window Minimization
description: Stops Windows from minimizing all other open background windows when quickly shaking or dragging a title bar.

name: Instant Window Minimize & Maximize Animations
description: Disables slow window zoom and expand animations so application windows snap open and close instantaneously.

name: Disable 'Shortcut to' Prefix on Shortcuts
description: Prevents Windows Explorer from automatically adding '- Shortcut' to the title of new desktop and start menu shortcuts.

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting Popups
description: Suppresses sluggish WerFault.exe crash report dialogs and background dump writes when an application encounters an error.

name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
description: Allows the graphics card to manage its own video memory directly, significantly reducing rendering latency in modern titles.

name: Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (Fix Stutter & Blackscreens)
description: Disables buggy Windows Desktop Window Manager MPO overlays, fixing cursor flickering, hitching, and black screens on NVIDIA/AMD GPUs.

name: Prefer Discrete High-Performance GPU Everywhere
description: Forces Windows Desktop Window Manager and 3D graphics applications to default to the discrete dedicated GPU.

name: Disable GPU Driver Energy Throttling
description: Prevents Windows PowerThrottling subsystem from forcing display adapter and graphics driver threads into power-saving states.

name: Disable Diagnostic Data Telemetry (AllowTelemetry = 0)

name: Disable Customer Experience Improvement Program
description: Stops CEIP anonymous application usage telemetry and background scheduled SQM collection tasks.

name: Disable Start Menu Bing Web Search & Cortana
description: Removes online Bing web search latency from the Start Menu, providing lightning-fast 0ms local file and app search.

name: Disable Windows Advertising ID Profile
description: Prevents Windows and installed applications from tracking your activity across apps for targeted advertising.

name: Disable NTFS 8.3 Short Name Creation
description: Disables legacy MS-DOS 8.3 filename generation on NTFS volumes, boosting folder traversal and file creation speed.

name: Disable NTFS Last Access Time Updates
description: Eliminates disk write overhead every time a directory or file is read by games and applications.

name: Increase NTFS Master File Table Reservation
description: Expands MFT zone allocation (Reservation=2), preventing fragmentation of the file table on SSDs and gaming drives.

name: Spectre & Meltdown Speculative Execution Bypass (Game Overdrive)
description: Disables Spectre Variant 2 and Meltdown mitigations via Memory Management registry flags, unlocking 5-15% raw CPU compute throughput.

name: Enable DirectFlip & Low Latency Independent Flip (IFlip)

name: Disable GameBar Presence Writer (DirectX Frame Hook Killer)

name: CSRSS Client-Server Runtime High Priority (Input Response)

name: DWM Desktop Window Manager High Priority (Display Engine)

name: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap (FTH Performance Sandbox)
description: Stops Windows from running high-load games and apps in a slow Fault Tolerant Heap sandbox.

name: Zero QoS Reserved Bandwidth (100% Download & Game Bandwidth)
description: Eliminates the 20% QoS packet scheduler bandwidth reservation, unlocking 100% maximum line speed.

name: Ultra-Fast DNS Cache TTL & Zero Negative Lookup Wait
description: Configures DNS Cache service with 86400s positive TTL and 0s failure penalty for instantaneous server connection.

name: Ultra-Fast Hung App Timeout & Instant Shutdown
description: Reduces hung application wait timeout to 1000ms and enables auto-end tasks on system shutdown.

name: Gameloop, MuMu Player & Google Play Games Realtime Priority
description: Sets High CPU & IO priority for Gameloop (AppMarket.exe, AndroidProcess.exe), MuMu Player (MuMuPlayer.exe), and Google Play PC (crosvm.exe).

name: Disable Windows Global Power Throttling & EcoQoS
description: Completely disables Windows kernel power throttling, preventing background or foreground task frequency capping.

name: MMCSS Extreme Gaming Scheduling Category (Priority 6 & GPU 8)
description: Configures Multimedia Class Scheduler Service to grant games 100% CPU reservation, High scheduling category, and GPU Priority 8.

name: NVIDIA Control Panel Telemetry Opt-Out
description: Disables telemetry tracking inside the NVIDIA Control Panel and Display driver.

name: Disable Windows Copilot & Recall AI Background Analysis
description: Disables Windows Copilot AI, Recall screenshot analysis, and background neural engine scanning.

name: Disable USB Selective Suspend (Zero Mouse Sleep Delay)
description: Forces USB hub ports to stay in high-power state at all times, preventing gaming mice and keyboards from micro-sleeping.

name: Audiodg.exe Realtime CPU & I/O Priority (DPC Latency Fix)
description: Sets Windows Audio Device Graph Isolation to High Priority, eliminating audio crackling and DPC spikes.

name: Enforce 0.5ms Global Hardware Timer Resolution

name: Linear 1:1 Raw Mouse Tracking Curve (Zero Curve Bias)

name: Disable Sticky Keys & Filter Keys Shift Shortcut Popups

name: 10GB DirectX & Vulkan Disk Shader Cache (Anti-Stutter)

name: DWM Max Queued Frames = 1 (Ultra-Low Compositor Latency)

name: Disable Dynamic Refresh Rate (DRR) Downclocking

name: TCP Max Hash Table Size & Free TCB Expansion (65536)

name: Disable NTFS File Tunneling Cache

name: Increase Storage Subsystem I/O Worker Threads (Count=64)

name: Disable Kernel Crash Dump RAM Reservation

name: Gameloop AOW Engine Realtime CPU & I/O Priority

name: Disable Windows Push Notifications Background Dispatcher

name: Disable Microsoft Edge Background Pre-launch & Tab Preloading

name: TCP Fast Open (TFO) Client & Server Acceleration

name: Double NTFS Directory & MFT Cache in RAM (NtfsMemoryUsage=2)

name: Run File Explorer in Separate Multithreaded Process

name: Eliminate 10-Second Windows Startup App Launch Delay

name: Persistent Disk Thumbnail Cache (Zero Reload Lag)
